Explain:
Pre-mod is required[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/991]自定义机器[/url]
Five kinds of machines were added to improve the quality of goods.
Crop Quality Improver: It can improve the quality of mature crops, fruits, vegetables and flowers.
Food Quality Improver: Improve the quality of cooking food.
Craftsman Quality Improver: Improve the quality of animal and craftsman goods. Because the price of pickles, honey and barrels is not good, they are not added.
Fish quality elevator: improve the quality of aquatic products. Besides fish, crab cage products can also be used, clams can also be used.
Gemstone Quality Elevator: Improve the quality of gemstones. Similar to diamonds, the stones knocked out by crystal holes are not counted.
Production costs are not particularly high, but time consuming
Ordinary Silver Star takes 12 hours to increase its value by 25%.
Silver Venus takes 12 hours to increase its value by 25%.
Venus Iridium takes 24 hours to increase its value by 50%.
